title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Naming Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9461 DNS SVCB naming/default-port surface.
scope: This verification covers scheme `dns`, node name `_dns`, per-transport default port selection, Port Prefix Naming for port 53 versus non-default ports, service-name construction for DNS hostnames, and validation that authentication names are DNS hostnames or literal IP addresses.
preconditions: The RFC 9461 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9461.json`.
DNS service binding behavior remains in `Incursa.Quic.Dns` rather than in the transport runtime.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9461 tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9461 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The RFC 9461 DNS SVCB naming/default-port floor is trace-owned and verified. SVCB record parsing, DoH URI-template dispatch, resolver discovery, and provisioning flows remain future work.
